sections.sub: About 10 minutes, all from your phone. Do the 3 marked DO FIRST today.

sections.label: DO FIRST
sections.title: 1. Hours
sections.where: Google Maps > your business > Edit profile > Hours
sections.text:
Your listings disagree: Birdeye says 24/7, MapQuest says Mon–Fri 7–4. Pick the one that's true.

If you answer emergency calls: set Monday–Friday 7:00 AM – 4:00 PM. Then tap More hours > Add > pick "Emergency" if it's listed and set it to Open 24 hours. Not listed? Skip it — your description and Q&A will say it.

If you don't: Monday–Friday 7:00 AM – 4:00 PM, Saturday and Sunday Closed.

sections.label: DO FIRST
sections.title: 2. Categories
sections.where: Edit profile > Business information > Business category
sections.text:
Primary category: Plumber

Add as additional (each one only if it shows up when you type it):
Drainage service
Water heater installation service
Gas installation service
Emergency plumber (only if you take after-hours calls)

sections.label: DO FIRST
sections.title: 3. Description (575 characters)
sections.text:
Riverbend Plumbing Co. is a local plumber at 118 Main St in Millbrook, Arkansas, serving homes and businesses since 2021. We handle plumbing repairs, leak detection, drain and main sewer line clearing, hydro jetting, line locating, gas line installation and repair, fixture and faucet installs, remodel plumbing, and water heater repair and replacement. If your main line backs up, a pipe starts leaking or your water heater quits, call us and a local plumber will come take a look. We work on houses and commercial buildings in Millbrook, Oak Hill, Danville, Pine Ridge and Stanton.

Don't serve one of these towns? Delete it before you paste.

sections.title: 4. Services
sections.where: Edit profile > Services (add each one with its line)
sections.text:
Plumbing repair - Leaks, broken pipes and fixtures fixed.
Leak detection - We find hidden leaks before they do damage.
Drain and sewer cleaning - Clogged drains and main lines cleared.
Hydro jetting - High-pressure water to scour sewer lines clean.
Line locating - We find buried water and sewer lines.
Water heater repair and replacement - Water heaters fixed or swapped out.
Fixture installation - Faucets, toilets, sinks and more put in right.
Remodel plumbing - Plumbing for kitchen and bath remodels and additions.
Gas line installation and repair - Gas lines run, tested and repaired.
Commercial plumbing - Repairs and service for local businesses.

sections.title: 5. Questions customers ask (5 Q&A pairs)
sections.where: Your website FAQ, and Google Q&A if your profile still shows it
sections.text:
Q: Do you handle emergency calls?
A: Yes, call (555) 010-2200. [Delete this answer if you don't take after-hours calls.]

Q: Can you clear a backed-up main sewer line?
A: Yes. We clear drains and main lines, and we do hydro jetting for lines that keep clogging.

Q: Do you replace water heaters?
A: Yes. We repair and replace water heaters. Call (555) 010-2200 for a quote.

Q: Do you work on businesses as well as homes?
A: Yes. We do residential and commercial plumbing.

Q: What are your hours?
A: Office hours are Monday to Friday, 7 am to 4 pm. [Emergency line: call (555) 010-2200 anytime — delete if not.]

sections.title: 6. 10 photo ideas (add 2 a week)
items: Your truck parked out front of 118 Main St with the shop sign showing.
You or your crew next to the truck, smiling, in work clothes.
A new water heater you just installed, before the closet door shuts.
Before and after of a cleaned-out drain or sewer cleanout.
The jetter hooked up and running at a job (no customer house numbers).
A camera or locator screen showing a line you found.
A finished faucet or toilet install, wiped clean, good light.
A remodel bathroom with the rough-in plumbing done.
Your tools laid out neat on a tailgate.
A commercial job in Millbrook (ask the owner first, no signs if they say no).

sections.sub: Real customers only. Everyone gets the same link. No gifts or discounts for reviews.

sections.title: Find your review link (1 minute)
sections.where: Google Maps > your business > Ask for reviews (or Get more reviews) > Share
sections.text:
Fastest: Google Maps > your business > Ask for reviews > Copy link, then paste it in a reply to our email.

Even easier: add ridgelinemarketinghq@gmail.com as a Manager (Edit profile > ⋮ > Business profile settings > People and access). We grab the link and set everything up. No password needed.

We'll put your link in the text below, on a counter card (QR code) you can print, and in the review emails we send your customers.

sections.title: Text to send after a job (202 characters)
sections.text: Hi, it's [your name] with Riverbend Plumbing Co. in Millbrook. Thanks for having us out! If you have a minute, would you leave us a quick Google review? It helps local folks find us: [your review link]

sections.title: One line for your techs
sections.text: If you're happy with the work today, would you leave us a quick Google review? I'll text you the link.

Send us 10 customer emails and we'll ask for you. Reply with names and emails of real customers (a list or a spreadsheet). We email each one a short review request from Riverbend Plumbing Co., once, with your link.
